API Reference#

This section provides detailed documentation for the pyvista-js public API.

Plotting#

pyvista_js.Plotter

Main plotting interface for pyvista-js.

Camera#

pyvista_js.Camera

Represents a virtual camera in a 3D scene.

Lighting#

pyvista_js.Light

Light class.

Data#

pyvista_js.PointData

Dict-like container for point data arrays.

Mesh#

pyvista_js.PolyData

Base polygonal mesh class.

pyvista_js.UnstructuredGrid

Unstructured grid dataset.

pyvista_js.CellType

VTK cell type constants.

pyvista_js.Arrow

Create an arrow mesh.

pyvista_js.Sphere

Create a sphere mesh.

pyvista_js.Cube

Create a cube mesh.

pyvista_js.Cylinder

Create a cylinder mesh.

pyvista_js.Cone

Create a cone mesh.

pyvista_js.Plane

Create a plane mesh.

pyvista_js.Disc

Create a disc (annular ring) geometric primitive.

pyvista_js.Circle

Create a circle defined by a set of points in the XY plane.

pyvista_js.Line

Create a line segment between two points.

Text#

pyvista_js.Text

A text annotation actor for 3D rendering.

pyvista_js.TextProperty

Properties for text rendering.

Texture#

pyvista_js.Texture

Surface texture wrapping an image URL.

Filters#

pyvista_js.PolyData.clip

Clip the mesh with a plane.

pyvista_js.PolyData.contour

Generate contour lines at constant scalar values.

pyvista_js.PolyData.fill_holes

Fill holes in a polygonal mesh.

pyvista_js.PolyData.shrink

Shrink the cells of a mesh towards their centroid.

pyvista_js.PolyData.texture_map_to_plane

Generate texture coordinates by projecting points onto the XY plane.

pyvista_js.PolyData.triangulate

Triangulate the mesh, converting all polygons to triangles.

pyvista_js.PolyData.tube

Generate a tube around a line polydata.

Readers#

pyvista_js.GLTFReader

Reader for glTF (GL Transmission Format) files (.gltf or .glb).

pyvista_js.OBJReader

Reader for Wavefront OBJ files (.obj).

pyvista_js.PLYReader

Reader for PLY (Polygon File Format) files (.ply).

pyvista_js.PolyDataReader

Reader for legacy VTK PolyData files (.vtk).

pyvista_js.STLReader

Reader for STL (STereoLithography) files (.stl).

Examples#

pyvista_js.examples.CubeMap

Cubemap texture holding six face image URLs.

pyvista_js.examples.download_bunny

Download the Stanford Bunny dataset.

pyvista_js.examples.download_lucy

Download the Lucy Angel dataset.

pyvista_js.examples.download_cad_model

Download the CAD model dataset.

pyvista_js.examples.download_damaged_helmet

Download the damaged helmet glTF example.

pyvista_js.examples.download_masonry_texture

Download the masonry texture dataset.

pyvista_js.examples.download_sky_box_cube_map

Download the skybox cube map dataset.

pyvista_js.examples.download_trumpet

Download the trumpet dataset.

CLI#

See the CLI reference for command-line usage documentation.
